SK-03.c01: The road test is the **third** and last skills test; the examiner scores specific maneuvers and your **general driving behavior** the whole time.
A **critical driving error** ends the test as an **automatic failure**, no matter how few other errors you have.
**Coasting** is moving out of gear, with the clutch pressed in or the shift lever in Neutral.
A **safe gap** means you can see the rear tires of the vehicle ahead touching the road.
**Double-clutch** means pressing and releasing the clutch twice to shift an unsynchronized manual transmission.
SK-03.c02: To pass, make **no more than 30 errors** and **no critical driving errors**.
Wear your **safety belt**, obey all signs, signals and laws, and finish **without an accident or moving violation**.
English only: 2 verbal warnings, and the **3rd** language offense on the same date is automatic failure; you get **3 attempts** in total.
Backup cameras can't be your only aid; a Class B test needs a truck, bus or single vehicle with GVWR **26,001 lb or more**.
SK-03.c03: Check traffic **in all directions**, signal, and slow smoothly; being out of gear for **more than your vehicle's length** is unsafe coasting.
If you stop, stop fully **behind** the line, where you can **see the rear tires** of the vehicle ahead.
While waiting, don't roll and keep the **front wheels straight ahead**.
Turn with **both hands on the wheel**, watch the mirror for the inside of the turn, and don't swing into oncoming traffic.
After the turn, cancel the signal, reach traffic speed, and move to the **right-most lane** when safe.
SK-03.c04: Approach intersections checking all directions, braking smoothly, and stopping completely behind the line with a **safe gap**.
**Do not enter** an intersection without **room to clear it**, because a long vehicle stuck inside blocks cross traffic.
In the intersection, **yield** to pedestrians and traffic, **don't change lanes**, and keep your hands on the wheel.
SK-03.c05: In business areas, stay **centered in the right-most lane**, keep a safe following distance, and **never exceed** the posted speed limit.
You will change lanes **to the left, then back to the right**: traffic checks, signal, and wait for a safe gap.
On the expressway, **merge smoothly**, keep proper lane position, spacing and speed, and slow down **in the exit lane**.
SK-03.c06: To pull over, check traffic, use the **right** signal, and stop fully **without coasting**, parallel and out of traffic.
Once stopped, cancel the signal, turn on the **4-way flashers**, set the parking brake, shift to Neutral or Park, and take feet off the pedals.
To go again, check mirrors, turn **off** the flashers, turn on the **left** signal, release the parking brake and **pull straight ahead**.
**Don't turn the wheel before the vehicle moves**; check traffic especially to the left, then cancel the left signal.
SK-03.c07: **Slow down before a curve** so you don't need to brake or shift in it.
At every railroad crossing, look and listen for trains; while **any part** of the vehicle is in the crossing, **don't stop, shift, pass or change lanes**.

Buses, school buses and placarded vehicles (at every crossing **unless exempt**) turn on the **4-way flashers**, stop **15 to 50 feet** from the nearest rail, and turn flashers off **after** crossing.
If the route has no crossing, you may have to **explain and demonstrate** the steps at a **simulated** location.
SK-03.c08: After an **overpass** you may be asked the **posted clearance**; after a **bridge**, the **posted weight limit**.
With no bridge or overpass, be ready to **name and explain** any other traffic sign on the route.
For a **school bus endorsement**, you must demonstrate **loading and unloading students**.
SK-03.c09: Always use the clutch to shift and **double-clutch** on an unsynchronized transmission; don't ride, pop or coast with the clutch.
Pick a gear that doesn't rev or lug the engine, and **don't shift in turns or intersections**.
Brake **smoothly with steady pressure**; don't ride, pump or brake harshly.
Finish a **left turn** in the lane directly right of the center line, and a **right turn** in the **right-most (curb) lane**.
SK-03.c10: Don't over-steer or under-steer; keep **both hands on the wheel** except while shifting.
Check traffic and mirrors regularly, including **before, during and after** each intersection.
Use turn signals properly and at the right time, and **cancel** them after the turn or lane change.
